Then tha glory of tha LORD departed from off tha threshold of tha house, N stood over tha cherubims.

11.text: Moreover tha spirit lifted me up, N brought me 2 tha east gate of tha LORD’s house, which looks eastward: N look at tha door of tha gate five N twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah tha son of Azur, N Pelatiah tha son of Benaiah, princes of tha people.

y’all have multiplied ur killed in dis city, N y’all have filled tha streets of it wit tha killed.
Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; ur killed whom y’all have laid in tha midst of it, dey r tha flesh, N dis city is tha caldron: but I will bring u forth out of tha midst of it.

N I will bring u out of tha midst of it, N deliver u in2 tha hands of strangers, N will execute judgments among u.

N it happened, when I prophesied, dat Pelatiah tha son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, N cried wit a loud voice, N said, Ah Lord GOD! will u make a full end of tha remnant of Israel?
Again tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,

Son of man, ur brothers, even ur brothers, tha men of ur kindred, N all tha house of Israel wholly, r dey 2 whom tha inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get u far from tha LORD: 2 us is dis land given in possession.

Therefore say, like dis says tha Lord GOD; Although I have cast ’em far off among tha heathen, N although I have scattered ’em among tha countries, yet will I be 2 ’em as a little sanctuary in tha countries where dey shall come.

N dey shall come there, N dey shall take away all tha detestable things of it N all tha abominations of it from thence.
N I will give ’em one heart, N I will put a new spirit within u; N I will take tha stony heart out of their flesh, N will give ’em an heart of flesh:

But as 4 ’em whose heart walks after tha heart of their detestable things N their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, says tha Lord GOD.
Then did tha cherubims lift up their wings, N tha wheels beside ’em; N tha glory of tha God of Israel was over ’em above.

12.text: Tha word of tha LORD also came 2 me, sayin,

N in tha morning came tha word of tha LORD 2 me, sayin,

But I will leave a few men of ’em from tha sword, from tha famine, N from tha pestilence; dat dey may declare all their abominations among tha heathen where dey come; N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD.
Moreover tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Son of man, eat ur bread wit quaking, N drink ur water wit tremblin N wit carefulness;

N say 2 tha people of tha land, like dis says tha Lord GOD of tha inhabitants of Jerusalem, N of tha land of Israel; dey shall eat their bread wit carefulness, N drink their water wit astonishment, dat her land may be desolate from all dat is in it, because of tha violence of all ’em dat live in it.

4 I am tha LORD: I will speak, N tha word dat I shall speak shall come 2 pass; it shall be no more prolonged: 4 in ur days, O rebellious house, will I say tha word, N will perform it, says tha Lord GOD.

13.text: N tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,

Like dis says tha Lord GOD; woe 2 tha foolish prophets, dat follow their own spirit, N have seen nothing!

y’all have not gone up in2 tha gaps, neither made up tha hedge 4 tha house of Israel 2 stand in tha battle in tha day of tha LORD.

Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because y’all have spoken vanity, N seen lies, therefore, look, I am against u, says tha Lord GOD.

N mine hand shall be upon tha prophets dat see vanity, N dat divine lies: dey shall not be in tha assembly of my people, neither shall dey be written in tha writing of tha house of Israel, neither shall dey enter in2 tha land of Israel; N y’all shall know dat I am tha Lord GOD.
Because, even because dey have seduced my people, sayin, Peace; N there was no peace; N one built up a wall, N, look, others daubed it wit untempered morter:

N say, like dis says tha Lord GOD; woe 2 tha women dat sew pillows 2 all armholes, N make kerchiefs upon tha head of every stature 2 hunt souls! Will y’all hunt tha souls of my people, N will y’all save tha souls alive dat come 2 u?

14.text: Then came certain of tha elders of Israel 2 me, N sat before me.

16.text: Again tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,

I clothed u also wit broidered work, N shod u wit badgers’ skin, N I girded u about wit fine linen, N I covered u wit silk.

Like dis were u decked wit gold N silver; N ur clothing was of fine linen, N silk, N broidered work; u did eat fine flour, N honey, N oil: N u were exceeding beautiful, N u did prosper in2 a kingdom.
N ur renown went forth among tha heathen 4 ur beauty: 4 it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon u, says tha Lord GOD.
But u did trust in ur own beauty, N playedst tha harlot because of ur renown, N pouredst out ur fornications on every one dat passed by; his it was.
N of ur garments u did take, N deckedst ur high places wit divers colours, N playedst tha harlot thereupon: tha like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
u have also taken ur fair jewels of my gold N of my silver, which I had given u, N made 2 urself images of men, N did commit whoredom wit ’em,

Dat u have killed my children, N delivered ’em 2 cause ’em 2 pass through tha fire 4 ’em?
N in all thine abominations N ur whoredoms u have not remembered tha days of ur youth, when u were naked N bare, N were polluted in ur blood.
N it happened after all ur wickedness, (woe, woe 2 u! says tha Lord GOD;)
Dat u have also built 2 u an eminent place, N have made u an high place in every street.
u have built ur high place at every head of tha way, N have made ur beauty 2 be abhorred, N have opened ur feet 2 every one dat passed by, N multiplied ur whoredoms.
u have also committed fornication wit tha Egyptians ur neighbours, great of flesh; N have increased ur whoredoms, 2 provoke me 2 anger.

Look, therefore I have stretched out my hand over u, N have diminished thine ordinary food, N delivered u 2 tha will of ’em dat hate u, tha daughters of tha Philistines, which r ashamed of ur lewd way.

In dat u build thine eminent place in tha head of every way, N make thine high place in every street; N have not been as an harlot, in dat u scornest hire;
But as a wife dat commits adultery, which takes strangers instead of her husband!

Like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because ur filthiness was poured out, N ur nakedness discovered through ur whoredoms wit ur lovers, N wit all tha idols of ur abominations, N by tha blood of ur children, which u did give 2 ’em;

Look, therefore I will gather all ur lovers, wit whom u have taken pleasure, N all ’em dat u have loved, wit all ’em dat u have hated; I will even gather ’em round about against u, N will discover ur nakedness 2 ’em, dat dey may see all ur nakedness.

Look, dis was tha iniquity of ur sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, N abundance of idleness was in her N in her daughters, neither did she strengthen tha hand of tha poor N needy.
N dey were haughty, N committed abomination before me: therefore I took ’em away as I saw good.
Neither has Samaria committed half of ur sins; but u have multiplied thine abominations more than dey, N have justified ur sisters in all thine abominations which u have done.

u also, which have judged ur sisters, bear ur own shame 4 ur sins dat u have committed more abominable than dey: dey r more righteous than u: yeah, be u confounded also, N bear ur shame, in dat u have justified ur sisters.
When I shall bring again their captivity, tha captivity of Sodom N her daughters, N tha captivity of Samaria N her daughters, then will I bring again tha captivity of ur captives in tha midst of ’em:
Dat u may bear ur own shame, N may be confounded in all dat u have done, in dat u r a comfort 2 ’em.

4 ur sister Sodom was not mentioned by ur mouth in tha day of ur pride,

N I will establish my covenant wit u; N u will know dat I am tha LORD:
Dat u may remember, N be confounded, N never open ur mouth any more because of ur shame, when I am pacified toward u 4 all dat u have done, says tha Lord GOD.

17.text: N tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,

N say, like dis says tha Lord GOD; A great eagle wit great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came 2 Lebanon, N took tha highest branch of tha cedar:

Say u, like dis says tha Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up tha roots of it, N cut off tha fruit of it, dat it wither? it shall wither in all tha leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people 2 pluck it up by tha roots of it.

4 she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as tha flesh of asses, N whose issue is like tha issue of horses.
Like dis u calledst 2 remembrance tha lewdness of ur youth, in bruising ur teats by tha Egyptians 4 tha paps of ur youth.
Therefore, O Aholibah, like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I will raise up ur lovers against u, from whom ur mind is alienated, N I will bring ’em against u on every side;
Tha Babylonians, N all tha Chaldeans, Pekod, N Shoa, N Koa, N all tha Assyrians wit ’em: all of ’em desirable young men, captains N rulers, great lords N renowned, all of ’em ridin upon horses.

N dey shall come against u wit chariots, wagons, N wheels, N wit an assembly of people, which shall set against u buckler N shield N helmet round about: N I will set judgment before ’em, N dey shall judge u according 2 their judgments.

N I will set my jealousy against u, N dey shall deal furiously wit u: dey shall take away ur nose N thine ears; N ur remnant shall fall by tha sword: dey shall take ur sons N ur daughters; N ur residue shall be devoured by tha fire.
Dey shall also strip u out of ur clothes, N take away ur fair jewels.
Like dis will I make ur lewdness 2 cease from u, N ur whoredom brought from tha land of Egypt: so dat u will not lift up ur eyes 2 ’em, nor remember Egypt any more.
4 like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I will deliver u in2 tha hand of ’em whom u hate, in2 tha hand of ’em from whom ur mind is alienated:
N dey shall deal wit u hatefully, N shall take away all ur labour, N shall leave u naked N bare: N tha nakedness of ur whoredoms shall be discovered, both ur lewdness N ur whoredoms.
I will do dese things 2 u, because u have gone a whoring after tha heathen, N because u r polluted wit their idols.
u have walked in tha way of ur sister; therefore will I give her cup in2 thine hand.
Like dis says tha Lord GOD; u will drink of ur sister’s cup deep N large: u will be laughed 2 scorn N had in derision; it containeth much.
u will be filled wit drunkenness N sorrow, wit tha cup of astonishment N desolation, wit tha cup of ur sister Samaria.
u will even drink it N suck it out, N u will break tha sherds of it, N pluck off ur own breasts: 4 I have spoken it, says tha Lord GOD.
Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because u have forgotten me, N cast me behind ur back, therefore bear u also ur lewdness N ur whoredoms.
Tha LORD said moreover 2 me; Son of man, will u judge Aholah N Aholibah? yeah, declare 2 ’em their abominations;

Dat dey have committed adultery, N blood is in their hands, N wit their idols have dey committed adultery, N have also caused their sons, whom dey bare 2 me, 2 pass 4 ’em through tha fire, 2 devour ’em.
Moreover dis dey have done 2 me: dey have defiled my sanctuary in tha same day, N have profaned my sabbaths.
4 when dey had killed their children 2 their idols, then dey came tha same day in2 my sanctuary 2 profane it; N, look, like dis have dey done in tha midst of mine house.
N furthermore, dat y’all have sent 4 men 2 come from far, 2 whom a messenger was sent; N, look, dey came: 4 whom u did wash urself, paintedst ur eyes, N deckedst urself wit ornaments,
N satest upon a stately bed, N a table prepared before it, whereupon u have set mine incense N mine oil.
N a voice of a crowd bein at ease was wit her: N wit tha men of tha common sort were brought Sabeans from tha wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, N beautiful crowns upon their heads.
Then said I 2 her dat was old in adulteries, Will dey now commit whoredoms wit her, N she wit ’em?
Yet dey went in 2 her, as dey go in 2 a woman dat playeth tha harlot: so went dey in 2 Aholah N 2 Aholibah, tha lewd women.
N tha righteous men, dey shall judge ’em after tha manner of adulteresses, N after tha manner of women dat shed blood; because dey r adulteresses, N blood is in their hands.
4 like dis says tha Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon ’em, N will give ’em 2 be removed N spoiled.
N tha company shall stone ’em wit stones, N dispatch ’em wit their swords; dey shall kill their sons N their daughters, N burn up their houses wit fire.
Like dis will I cause lewdness 2 cease out of tha land, dat all women may be taught not 2 do after ur lewdness.
N dey shall recompense ur lewdness upon u, N y’all shall bear tha sins of ur idols: N y’all shall know dat I am tha Lord GOD.

24.text: Again in tha ninth year, in tha tenth month, in tha tenth day of tha month, tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Son of man, write u tha name of tha day, even of dis same day: tha king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem dis same day.
N utter a parable 2 tha rebellious house, N say 2 ’em, like dis says tha Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set it on, N also pour water in2 it:
Gather tha pieces of it in2 it, even every good piece, tha thigh, N tha shoulder; fill it wit tha choice bones.
Take tha choice of tha flock, N burn also tha bones under it, N make it boil well, N let ’em seethe tha bones of it in it.
So like dis says tha Lord GOD; woe 2 tha bloody city, 2 tha pot whose scum is in it, N whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
4 her blood is in tha midst of her; she set it upon tha top of a rock; she poured it not upon tha ground, 2 cover it wit dust;
Dat it might cause fury 2 come up 2 take vengeance; I have set her blood upon tha top of a rock, dat it should not be covered.
Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; woe 2 tha bloody city! I will even make tha pile 4 fire great.
Heap on wood, kindle tha fire, consume tha flesh, N spice it well, N let tha bones be burned.
Then set it empty upon tha coals of it, dat tha brass of it may be hot, N may burn, N dat tha filthiness of it may be molten in it, dat tha scum of it may be consumed.
She has wearied herself wit lies, N her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in tha fire.
In ur filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged u, N u were not purged, u will not be purged from ur filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury 2 rest upon u.

I tha LORD have spoken it: it will happen, N I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according 2 ur ways, N according 2 ur doings, shall dey judge u, says tha Lord GOD.
Also tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Son of man, look, I take away from u tha desire of ur eyes wit a stroke: yet neither will u mourn nor weep, neither shall ur tears run down.
Forbear 2 cry, make no mournin 4 tha dead, bind tha tire of thine head upon u, N put on ur shoes upon ur feet, N cover not ur lips, N eat not tha bread of men.
So I spoke 2 tha people in tha morning: N at even my wife died; N I did in tha morning as I was commanded.
N tha people said 2 me, will u not tell us what dese things r 2 us, dat u do so?
Then I answered ’em, tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,

Speak 2 tha house of Israel, like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I will profane my sanctuary, tha excellency of ur strength, tha desire of ur eyes, N dat which ur soul pitieth; N ur sons N ur daughters whom y’all have left shall fall by tha sword.
N y’all shall do as I have done: y’all shall not cover ur lips, nor eat tha bread of men.
N ur tires shall be upon ur heads, N ur shoes upon ur feet: y’all shall not mourn nor weep; but y’all shall pine away 4 ur iniquities, N mourn one toward another.
Like dis Ezekiel is 2 u a sign: according 2 all dat he has done shall y’all do: N when dis comes, y’all shall know dat I am tha Lord GOD.

Also, u son of man, shall it not be in tha day when I take from ’em their strength, tha joy of their glory, tha desire of their eyes, N dat whereupon dey set their minds, their sons N their daughters,
Dat he dat escapes in dat day shall come 2 u, 2 cause u 2 hear it wit thine ears?
In dat day shall ur mouth be opened 2 him which is escaped, N u will speak, N be no more dumb: N u will be a sign 2 ’em; N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD.

25.text: Tha word of tha LORD came again 2 me, sayin,
Son of man, set ur face against tha Ammonites, N prophesy against ’em;

N say 2 tha Ammonites, Hear tha word of tha Lord GOD; like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because u said, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; N against tha land of Israel, when it was desolate; N against tha house of Judah, when dey went in2 captivity;
Look, therefore I will deliver u 2 tha men of tha east 4 a possession, N dey shall set their palaces in u, N make their dwellings in u: dey shall eat ur fruit, N dey shall drink ur milk.
N I will make Rabbah a stable 4 camels, N tha Ammonites a couchingplace 4 flocks: N y’all shall know dat I am tha LORD.
4 like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because u have clapped thine hands, N stamped wit tha feet, N rejoiced in heart wit all ur despite against tha land of Israel;

Look, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon u, N will deliver u 4 a spoil 2 tha heathen; N I will cut u off from tha people, N I will cause u 2 perish out of tha countries: I will destroy u; N u will know dat I am tha LORD.
Like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because dat Moab N Seir do say, look, tha house of Judah is like 2 all tha heathen;
Therefore, look, I will open tha side of Moab from tha citiez, from his citiez which r on his frontiers, tha glory of tha country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, N Kiriathaim,
2 tha men of tha east wit tha Ammonites, N will give ’em in possession, dat tha Ammonites may not be remembered among tha nations.
N I will execute judgments upon Moab; N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD.
Like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because dat Edom has dealt against tha house of Judah by takin vengeance, N has greatly offended, N revenged himself upon ’em;
Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, N will cut off man N beast from it; N I will make it desolate from Teman; N dey of Dedan shall fall by tha sword.
N I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by tha hand of my people Israel: N dey shall do in Edom according 2 mine anger N according 2 my fury; N dey shall know my vengeance, says tha Lord GOD.
Like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because tha Philistines have dealt by revenge, N have taken vengeance wit a despiteful heart, 2 destroy it 4 tha old hatred;
Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I will stretch out mine hand upon tha Philistines, N I will cut off tha Cherethims, N destroy tha remnant of tha sea coast.
N I will execute great vengeance upon ’em wit furious rebukes; N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon ’em.

26.text: N it happened in tha eleventh year, in tha first day of tha month, dat tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Son of man, because dat Tyrus has said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken dat was tha gates of tha people: she is turned 2 me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:
Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I am against u, O Tyrus, N will cause many nations 2 come up against u, as tha sea causes his waves 2 come up.
N dey shall destroy tha walls of Tyrus, N break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, N make her like tha top of a rock.
It shall be a place 4 tha spreading of nets in tha midst of tha sea: 4 I have spoken it, says tha Lord GOD: N it shall become a spoil 2 tha nations.
N her daughters which r in tha field shall be killed by tha sword; N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD.
4 like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from tha north, wit horses, N wit chariots, N wit horsemen, N companies, N much people.
He shall kill wit tha sword ur daughters in tha field: N he shall make a fort against u, N cast a mount against u, N lift up tha buckler against u.
N he shall set engines of war against ur walls, N wit his axes he shall break down ur towers.

By reason of tha abundance of his horses their dust shall cover u: ur walls shall shake at tha noise of tha horsemen, N of tha wheels, N of tha chariots, when he shall enter in2 ur gates, as men enter in2 a city in which is made a breach.
Wit tha hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all ur streets: he shall kill ur people by tha sword, N ur strong garrisons shall go down 2 tha ground.

N dey shall make a spoil of ur riches, N make a prey of ur merchandise: N dey shall break down ur walls, N destroy ur pleasant houses: N dey shall lay ur stones N ur timber N ur dust in tha midst of tha water.
N I will cause tha noise of ur songs 2 cease; N tha sound of ur harps shall be no more heard.
N I will make u like tha top of a rock: u will be a place 2 spread nets upon; u will be built no more: 4 I tha LORD have spoken it, says tha Lord GOD.
Like dis says tha Lord GOD 2 Tyrus; Shall not tha isles shake at tha sound of ur fall, when tha wounded cry, when tha slaughter is made in tha midst of u?

Then all tha princes of tha sea shall come down from their thrones, N lay away their robes, N put off their broidered garments: dey shall clothe themselves wit tremblin; dey shall sit upon tha ground, N shall tremble at every moment, N be astonished at u.

N dey shall take up a lamentation 4 u, N say 2 u, How r u destroyed, dat were inhabited of seafaring men, tha renowned city, which were strong in tha sea, she N her inhabitants, which cause their terror 2 be on all dat haunt it!
Now shall tha isles tremble in tha day of ur fall; yeah, tha isles dat r in tha sea shall be troubled at ur departure.
4 like dis says tha Lord GOD; When I shall make u a desolate city, like tha citiez dat r not inhabited; when I shall bring up tha deep upon u, N great waterz shall cover u;

When I shall bring u down wit ’em dat descend in2 tha pit, wit tha people of old time, N shall set u in tha low parts of tha earth, in places desolate of old, wit ’em dat go down 2 tha pit, dat u don’t be inhabited; N I shall set glory in tha land of tha livin;
I will make u a terror, N u will be no more: though u be sought 4, yet will u never be found again, says tha Lord GOD.

27.text: Tha word of tha LORD came again 2 me, sayin,
Now, u son of man, take up a lamentation 4 Tyrus;
N say 2 Tyrus, O u dat art situate at tha entry of tha sea, which art a merchant of tha people 4 many isles, like dis says tha Lord GOD; O Tyrus, u have said, I am of perfect beauty.
Ur borders r in tha midst of tha seas, ur builders have perfected ur beauty.
Dey have made all ur ship boards of fir trees of Senir: dey have taken cedars from Lebanon 2 make masts 4 u.
Of tha oaks of Bashan have dey made thine oars; tha company of tha Ashurites have made ur benches of ivory, brought out of tha isles of Chittim.
Fine linen wit broidered work from Egypt was dat which u spread forth 2 be ur sail; blue N purple from tha isles of Elishah was dat which covered u.
Tha inhabitants of Zidon N Arvad were ur mariners: ur wise men, O Tyrus, dat were in u, were ur pilots.
Tha ancients of Gebal N tha wise men of it were in u ur calkers: all tha ships of tha sea wit their mariners were in u 2 occupy ur merchandise.
Dey of Persia N of Lud N of Phut were in thine army, ur men of war: dey hanged tha shield N helmet in u; dey set forth ur comeliness.
Tha men of Arvad wit thine army were upon ur walls round about, N tha Gammadims were in ur towers: dey hanged their shields upon ur walls round about; dey have made ur beauty perfect.
Tarshish was ur merchant by reason of tha crowd of all kind of riches; wit silver, iron, tin, N lead, dey traded in ur fairs.
Javan, Tubal, N Meshech, dey were ur merchants: dey traded tha persons of men N vessels of brass in ur market.
Dey of tha house of Togarmah traded in ur fairs wit horses N horsemen N mules.
Tha men of Dedan were ur merchants; many isles were tha merchandise of thine hand: dey brought u 4 a present horns of ivory N ebony.
Syria was ur merchant by reason of tha crowd of tha wares of ur makin: dey occupied in ur fairs wit emeralds, purple, N broidered work, N fine linen, N coral, N agate.
Judah, N tha land of Israel, dey were ur merchants: dey traded in ur market wheat of Minnith, N Pannag, N honey, N oil, N balm.
Damascus was ur merchant in tha crowd of tha wares of ur makin, 4 tha crowd of all riches; in tha wine of Helbon, N white wool.
Dan also N Javan goin 2 N fro occupied in ur fairs: bright iron, cassia, N calamus, were in ur market.
Dedan was ur merchant in precious clothes 4 chariots.
Arabia, N all tha princes of Kedar, dey occupied wit u in lambs, N rams, N goats: in dese were dey ur merchants.
Tha merchants of Sheba N Raamah, dey were ur merchants: dey occupied in ur fairs wit chief of all spices, N wit all precious stones, N gold.
Haran, N Canneh, N Eden, tha merchants of Sheba, Asshur, N Chilmad, were ur merchants.
Dese were ur merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, N broidered work, N in chests of rich clothing, bound wit cords, N made of cedar, among ur merchandise.
Tha ships of Tarshish did sing of u in ur market: N u were replenished, N made very glorious in tha midst of tha seas.
Ur rowers have brought u in2 great waterz: tha east wind has broken u in tha midst of tha seas.

Ur riches, N ur fairs, ur merchandise, ur mariners, N ur pilots, ur calkers, N tha occupiers of ur merchandise, N all ur men of war, dat r in u, N in all ur company which is in tha midst of u, shall fall in2 tha midst of tha seas in tha day of ur ruin.
Tha suburbs shall shake at tha sound of tha cry of ur pilots.
N all dat handle tha oar, tha mariners, N all tha pilots of tha sea, shall come down from their ships, dey shall stand upon tha land;
N shall cause their voice 2 be heard against u, N shall cry bitterly, N shall cast up dust upon their heads, dey shall wallow themselves in tha ashes:
N dey shall make themselves utterly bald 4 u, N gird ’em wit sackcloth, N dey shall weep 4 u wit bitterness of heart N bitter wailing.
N in their wailing dey shall take up a lamentation 4 u, N lament over u, sayin, What city is like Tyrus, like tha destroyed in tha midst of tha sea?
When ur wares went forth out of tha seas, u filledst many people; u did enrich tha kings of tha earth wit tha crowd of ur riches N of ur merchandise.
In tha time when u will be broken by tha seas in tha depths of tha waterz ur merchandise N all ur company in tha midst of u shall fall.
All tha inhabitants of tha isles shall be astonished at u, N their kings shall be sore afraid, dey shall be troubled in their countenance.
Tha merchants among tha people shall hiss at u; u will be a terror, N never will be any more.

28.text: Tha word of tha LORD came again 2 me, sayin,

Son of man, say 2 tha prince of Tyrus, like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because thine heart is lifted up, N u have said, I am a God, I sit in tha seat of God, in tha midst of tha seas; yet u r a man, N not God, though u set thine heart as tha heart of God:
Look, u r wiser than Daniel; there is no secret dat dey can hide from u:
Wit ur wisdom N wit thine understanding u have got u riches, N have got gold N silver in2 ur treasures:
By ur great wisdom N by ur traffick have u increased ur riches, N thine heart is lifted up because of ur riches:
Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; Because u have set thine heart as tha heart of God;
Look, therefore I will bring strangers upon u, tha terrible of tha nations: N dey shall draw their swords against tha beauty of ur wisdom, N dey shall defile ur brightness.
Dey shall bring u down 2 tha pit, N u will die tha deaths of ’em dat r killed in tha midst of tha seas.
Will u yet say before him dat slayeth u, I am God? but u will be a man, N no God, in tha hand of him dat slayeth u.
u will die tha deaths of tha uncircumcised by tha hand of strangers: 4 I have spoken it, says tha Lord GOD.
Moreover tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Son of man, take up a lamentation upon tha king of Tyrus, N say 2 him, like dis says tha Lord GOD; u sealest up tha sum, full of wisdom, N perfect in beauty.

u have been in Eden tha garden of God; every precious stone was ur covering, tha sardius, topaz, N tha diamond, tha beryl, tha onyx, N tha jasper, tha sapphire, tha emerald, N tha carbuncle, N gold: tha workmanship of ur tabrets N of ur pipes was prepared in u in tha day dat u were created.
u r tha anointed cherub dat covers; N I have set u so: u were upon tha holy mountain of God; u have walked up N down in tha midst of tha stones of fire.
u were perfect in ur ways from tha day dat u were created, till iniquity was found in u.

By tha crowd of ur merchandise dey have filled tha midst of u wit violence, N u have sinned: therefore I will cast u as profane out of tha mountain of God: N I will destroy u, O covering cherub, from tha midst of tha stones of fire.
Thine heart was lifted up because of ur beauty, u have corrupted ur wisdom by reason of ur brightness: I will cast u 2 tha ground, I will lay u before kings, dat dey may look u.

u have defiled ur sanctuaries by tha crowd of thine iniquities, by tha iniquity of ur traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from tha midst of u, it shall devour u, N I will bring u 2 ashes upon tha earth in tha sight of all ’em dat look u.
All dey dat know u among tha people shall be astonished at u: u will be a terror, N never will u be any more.
Again tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Son of man, set ur face against Zidon, N prophesy against it,

N say, like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I am against u, O Zidon; N I will be glorified in tha midst of u: N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, N shall be sanctified in her.
4 I will send in2 her pestilence, N blood in2 her streets; N tha wounded shall be judged in tha midst of her by tha sword upon her on every side; N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD.
N there shall be no more a pricking brier 2 tha house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all dat r round about ’em, dat despised ’em; N dey shall know dat I am tha Lord GOD.

Like dis says tha Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered tha house of Israel from tha people among whom dey r scattered, N shall be sanctified in ’em in tha sight of tha heathen, then shall dey live in their land dat I have given 2 my servant Jacob.

N dey shall live safely in it, N shall build houses, N plant vineyards; yeah, dey shall live wit confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all dose dat despise ’em round about ’em; N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD their God.

29.text: In tha tenth year, in tha tenth month, in tha twelfth day of tha month, tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Son of man, set ur face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, N prophesy against him, N against all Egypt:

Speak, N say, like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I am against u, Pharaoh king of Egypt, tha great dragon dat lies in tha midst of his rivers, which has said, My river is my own, N I have made it 4 myself.
But I will put hooks in ur jaws, N I will cause tha fish of ur rivers 2 stick 2 ur scales, N I will bring u up out of tha midst of ur rivers, N all tha fish of ur rivers shall stick 2 ur scales.

N I will leave u thrown in2 tha wilderness, u N all tha fish of ur rivers: u will fall upon tha open fields; u will not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given u 4 food 2 tha beasts of tha field N 2 tha fowls of tha heaven.
N all tha inhabitants of Egypt shall know dat I am tha LORD, because dey have been a staff of reed 2 tha house of Israel.
When dey took hold of u by ur hand, u did break, N rend all their shoulder: N when dey leaned upon u, u brakest, N made all their loins 2 be at a stand.
Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I will bring a sword upon u, N cut off man N beast out of u.
N tha land of Egypt shall be desolate N waste; N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD: because he has said, tha river is mine, N I have made it.
Look, therefore I am against u, N against ur rivers, N I will make tha land of Egypt utterly waste N desolate, from tha tower of Syene even 2 tha border of Ethiopia.
No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

N I will make tha land of Egypt desolate in tha midst of tha countries dat r desolate, N her citiez among tha citiez dat r laid waste shall be desolate forty years: N I will scatter tha Egyptians among tha nations, N will disperse ’em through tha countries.
Yet like dis says tha Lord GOD; At tha end of forty years will I gather tha Egyptians from tha people where dey were scattered:
N I will bring again tha captivity of Egypt, N will cause ’em 2 return in2 tha land of Pathros, in2 tha land of their habitation; N dey shall be there a base kingdom.
It shall be tha basest of tha kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above tha nations: 4 I will diminish ’em, dat dey shall no more rule over tha nations.
N it will be no more tha confidence of tha house of Israel, which brings their iniquity 2 remembrance, when dey shall look after ’em: but dey shall know dat I am tha Lord GOD.
N it happened in tha seven N twentieth year, in tha first month, in tha first day of tha month, tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,

Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army 2 serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, N every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, 4 Tyrus, 4 tha service dat he had served against it:

Therefore like dis says tha Lord GOD; look, I will give tha land of Egypt 2 Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; N he shall take her crowd, N take her spoil, N take her prey; N it will be tha wages 4 his army.
I have given him tha land of Egypt 4 his labour wherewith he served against it, because dey wrought 4 me, says tha Lord GOD.
In dat day will I cause tha horn of tha house of Israel 2 bud forth, N I will give u tha opening of tha mouth in tha midst of ’em; N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD.

30.text: Tha word of tha LORD came again 2 me, sayin,
Son of man, prophesy N say, like dis says tha Lord GOD; Howl y’all, woe worth tha day!
4 tha day is near, even tha day of tha LORD is near, a cloudy day; it shall be tha time of tha heathen.
N tha sword shall come upon Egypt, N great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when tha killed shall fall in Egypt, N dey shall take away her crowd, N her foundations shall be broken down.
Ethiopia, N Libya, N Lydia, N all tha mingled people, N Chub, N tha men of tha land dat is in league, shall fall wit ’em by tha sword.
Like dis says tha LORD; dey also dat uphold Egypt shall fall; N tha pride of her power shall come down: from tha tower of Syene shall dey fall in it by tha sword, says tha Lord GOD.
N dey shall be desolate in tha midst of tha countries dat r desolate, N her citiez shall be in tha midst of tha citiez dat r wasted.
N dey shall know dat I am tha LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, N when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
In dat day shall messengers go forth from me in ships 2 make tha careless Ethiopians afraid, N great pain shall come upon ’em, as in tha day of Egypt: 4, look, it comes.
Like dis says tha Lord GOD; I will also make tha crowd of Egypt 2 cease by tha hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
